name: Case Successfully Created
description: Confirms that a new moderate-priority, social-channel case was created for Avery Ltd with correct contact, product, installed product linkage.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND account_id = 44 AND contact_id = 101 AND product_id = 140 AND installed_product_id = 243 AND channel = 'social' AND priority = 'moderate' AND state = 'new' AND short_description LIKE '%Product: Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 Variant 8, Issue:%';

name: Interaction Logged for the Case
description: Ensures that a handled interaction was registered for the same account/contact/case via social channel.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction WHERE account_id = 44 AND contact_id = 101 AND case_id = 1233 AND channel = 'social' AND status = 'handled';
